faq.waMessage: Hello Kafeinarts, I'd like to ask about your services.

items.q: What digital services does Kafeinarts offer?
items.a: We focus on SaaS product development, custom websites and web applications, UI/UX design, as well as cloud management and system security to support your business operations end to end.

items.q: How long does a SaaS application project usually take?
items.a: The timeline depends heavily on the scale, features, and complexity of the project. Small to medium management systems usually take 4-8 weeks. We provide a transparent, measurable timeline after the initial discussion and requirements analysis.

items.q: What technologies are used in development?
items.a: We build robust, modern system architectures. In general we use PHP, Laravel, or Node.js for the backend; HTML, CSS, Tailwind, and JavaScript for a responsive frontend; and relational databases such as MySQL to keep your data intact.

items.q: Do you provide maintenance after the app is launched?
items.a: Absolutely. We understand digital products need ongoing care to stay secure and perform well. We offer long-term technical support and maintenance packages covering bug fixes, security updates, and future feature additions.

items.q: What is the first step to start working together?
items.a: It's simple! Just contact us through the contact form or the order button. We'll schedule a relaxed discussion to understand your challenges, goals, and business needs. After that, we'll prepare a draft proposal covering the technical solution and estimated investment.
